goal: Locate single-month volume anomalies in offline_data/regional_sales.csv by computing each region×product_line monthly sales volume as a multiple of its own 24-month mean, report the top-3 combos with their multiples, months, and return rates, assess whether each spike is real demand or channel stuffing, and save a fully-sourced Markdown report to disk.

plan.title: Inspect CSV structure: Read offline_data/regional_sales.csv: list all column names, total row count, date range (min/max of the month column), and print first 5 rows as sample

Compute monthly volume anomaly ratios: Using the CSV, for each (region × product_line) group compute the 24-month rolling mean of monthly sales volume, then compute the ratio = current_month_volume / 24-month_mean for every month. Save the full result table to a CSV file (e.g. offline_data/volume_anomaly_ratios.csv)

Identify top-3 anomaly combos & fetch return rates: From the ratio CSV, find the top-3 (region × product_line × month) combinations with the highest volume-to-mean ratio. For each, also extract the corresponding return rate (退货率) from the original CSV. Save a small summary table to offline_data/top3_anomaly_summary.csv

Assess demand vs channel stuffing: For each of the top-3 combos, compute supporting evidence: (a) the 3-month trend before and after the spike month, (b) whether the spike is isolated or sustained, (c) return rate level vs the combo's 24-month average return rate. Save a structured assessment table to offline_data/stuffing_assessment.csv

Write Markdown report with embedded data: Write a complete Markdown report to offline_data/volume_anomaly_report.md. Requirements: (1) H1 title; (2) at least one data table showing the top-3 combos with ratio, month, return rate; (3) every key number annotated with source in the format '（来源：offline_data/regional_sales.csv 的 <列名>，<聚合口径与样本行数>）' or '（来源：由前述两行计算）'; (4) a concluding paragraph judging whether each spike is real demand or channel stuffing; (5) no external data. Embed the summary tables as Markdown tables directly in the file
